messages:
Alex Kim: Heads up — StormGate (enterprise) is seeing repeated timeouts on the dedicated pool since ~05:45 PT. CS escalated and flagged SLA risk. Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SG-427 :eyes:

Maya Patel: Thanks. Do we have logs/traces yet? Which model, seq len, and pool id?

Alex Kim: Quick snippet from pool3 (sanitized):
```
[2026-03-17T05:51:12Z] request_id=abc123 state=timeout model=redwood-4XL pool=pool3 seq_len=512 err=\"kvcache miss spikes, token loop exceeded\"
```
Tail latency spike >1s, error rate up ~4%. Reproducing locally now.

Jonah Reyes: I'll own the hotfix. First hypothesis: batching/backpressure + fallback not triggering fast enough. Triage + small runtime change to fallback policy. ETA: probe/confirm 45m, PR for patch in ~3h, canary rollout ~6h. @Priya Singh for rollout.

Priya Singh: On it. I need the exact traffic keys for the customer and any acceptable temporary QoS (e.g., route to smaller model). Also confirm canary window length.

Sara (oncall): Oncall watching. I'll set p99 latency and 5xx alerts and tag CS. Which mitigation should we apply now? Route to 4L or failover cluster?

Jonah Reyes: Immediate mitigation: route StormGate -> redwood-4L (us-west-2) + enable prefix cache warmup for their hot prefixes. That should reduce per-token work and cut tail. Plan: infra shift first, then runtime patch.

Alex Kim: Customer expects a timeline in ~30m. Can we commit to initial mitigation in 1 hour?

Jonah Reyes: Yes. I can prepare the routing patch now. If infra can apply the traffic shift, we should be able to complete the mitigation in ~45m.

infra-ops-bot: infra-ops-bot: scheduled traffic shift to redwood-4L for customer StormGate at 1923458090 (in ~15m) — please confirm.

Priya Singh: Confirmed. I'll lock a 2-hour canary window post-shift. If metrics stable, proceed with canary of patched runtime. Rollback playbook ready.

Maya Patel: I'll add extra tracing focused on kvcache hit/miss rates, batching queue length, and per-request seq_len distribution. Dashboard link will follow in ~20–30m.

Jonah Reyes: Quick workaround steps (for infra ops):
```
# shift traffic to smaller model in routing service
POST /v1/routing/shifts
payload: {
  "customer_id": "stormgate-cust-id",
  "target_model": "redwood-4L",
  "duration": 120
}
```
I'll open the PR for fallback fastpath after I confirm reproduction.

Alex Kim: Action items summary:
- Jonah: triage + hotfix PR (ETA 3h)
- Priya: prepare canary + rollback & apply traffic shift (ETA 45m)
- Sara: monitor p99/p95 + notify CS for customer updates (ongoing)
- Maya: traces/dashboard (ETA 30m)

Please react :thumbsup: to ack and we will use this thread as the single source of truth.

Priya Singh: :thumbsup:
Jonah Reyes: :thumbsup:
Maya Patel: :thumbsup:
Sara (oncall): :thumbsup:
Alex Kim: Thanks everyone — I'll post status updates here.
